steps.description: Load the module, call createScene(), then immediately call updateMatrixWorld(true)

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ CRITICAL: Call root.updateMatrixWorld(true) immediately after createScene().

steps.description: Treat ONLY named THREE.Group nodes with children as links — do NOT treat top-level scene nodes or meshes as links

suggestions: A link is a named THREE.Group that is NOT the root scene object. Check: obj.isGroup && obj.name && obj !== root.
Verify the resulting link list against the expected output — extra entries mean you are including the root or non-link nodes.
warnings: Do NOT treat the root scene object itself as a link. The root should be traversed but never added to the link list.

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ CRITICAL: Do not add the root scene object to the link list. Only named child groups are links.

steps.description: Assign each mesh to its nearest named ancestor group (the immediate link parent)
Bake world transforms: applyMatrix4(matrixWorld) then toNonIndexed()

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ The provided export_link_objs.mjs is missing toNonIndexed(). Write your own baking code.
❌ CRITICAL: After applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld), call toNonIndexed() if geom.index is set.

suggestions: Baking: let geom = mesh.geometry.clone(); geom.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld); if (geom.index) geom = geom.toNonIndexed();

steps.description: Export per-part OBJ using deterministic (sorted) part ordering

suggestions: Sort link names with localeCompare before exporting.
